links.comparator_used: Automated model predictions without flagging or revision of uncertain outputs
links.outcome: Fraction of predictions reaching human-level performance (Fractional Threshold, FT)
links.effect: Human revision of flagged outliers increased FT to 0.99, versus FT for DSC and NSD that remained lower than human performance in most cases without revision; 23-fold workload reduction
links.tradeoff: Average 1.54 minutes of human revision time per case; the model alone remained constrained by tail-case failures
links.quote: Human-in-the-loop revision of acquisition-flagged outliers increased FT to 0.99, with an average time of 1.54 minutes per case, corresponding to a 23-fold workload reduction.
